checked_claims.note: Poincare duality dictionary and Tate arithmetic match FND-0001: d=21, 2d-16=26, W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} ≅ W_26 H^{26}(21), Q(-13)(21)=Q(8); lowest-weight purity consistent with FND-0032/0033.
Forgetful fibre is a positively punctured genus-6 curve (affine, cd 1); R^{q≥2}=0 and residue SES 0→H→R^1→Q(-1)^{j-2}→0 with weight-two residues match FND-0020.
Two-row Leray with q=0 killed by vcd and no room for differentials into/out of E_2^{d_{j-1},1} is the standard FND-0036 pattern with coefficients; single E_∞ term, no filtration obstruction.
Uniform weight floor d_{j-1}+r+2=27 kills Gr^W_26 of residue quotients; W-strictness gives the stated surjections. FND-0037 connecting maps affect kernels only (FND-0093).
Composite surjection Gr^W_26 H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5}) ↠ Gr^W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) is exactly the reduction recorded in FND-0093; it does not prove the corner.

Universal closed curve: R^2=Q(-1), vcd kills E_2^{21,0} and E_2^{20,1}, differentials into/out of E^{19,2} vanish; H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5}) ≅ H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})(-1) as MHS is correct. Whole-group vanishing is a valid overstrengthening of Gr^W_24 vanishing.
Harer virtual duality: H^{vcd}(Mod_6;V) ≅ (St_6 ⊗_Q V)_{Mod_6} with Q-coefficients is standard for virtual duality groups.
H^{⊗5} is inflated from Sp_{12}(Z), so I_6 acts trivially and coinvariants stage as (S ⊗ H^{⊗5})_{Sp} with S=(St_6)_{I_6}⊗Q.
Central z=-1 acts as (-1)^5=-1 on H^{⊗5}; over Q the S^+ summand contributes 0 to coinvariants under ⟨z⟩, hence (S⊗V)_{Sp}=(S^-⊗V)_{Sp}. Arithmetic is correct; usefulness requires S^-=0.

Load-bearing generation claim fails as written. (5.3) asserts hyperelliptic/Birman–Hilden classes generate St_6⊗Q as a Q[Mod_6]-module, but the justification is incoherent: it equates Steinberg degree-10 classes with ‘fundamental classes of maximal simplices’ (maximal simplices have dim 3g-4=14, not 2g-2); it conflates pairwise-disjoint curve-complex simplices with intersecting Humphries chains of 2g+1 curves (which are not simplices of C); and the leap ‘every filling carrier is Mod_6-equivalent to a hyperelliptic chain because Mod acts transitively on Humphries chains’ does not follow. Nonvanishing of b: St(Σ_{0,14})→St_6 and generation by its Mod-orbit are not established (Broaddus cyclicity uses a different chord-diagram generator φ_0; FND-0092 already warns that naive filling generators can be zero). Without a correct proof that S=S^+, the z-argument does not yield S^-=0.
H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})=0 and the descended vanishings depend on CLM-0010/S^-=0, which failed. Church–Farb–Putman kill only trivial-coefficient top cohomology, not odd symplectic coefficients.
Exact-corner vanishing and ‘empty direct sum of Q(8)’ are contingent on CLM-0011; the reduction tower alone (FND-0093) does not settle RED-0001.
Dual boundary-restriction injectivity is presented as a corollary of CLM-0012; not established independently.
Non-load-bearing consistency remark: if the corner were zero, residual CE Gysin classes would vanish there. Does not prove vanishing and does not replace C66-GEO-*/TATE-*.

finding_candidates.evidence: ATT-0052 Step 5.3–5.4 and CLM-0010: claimed N=St_6⊗Q from ‘maximal simplices’, ‘filling systems’, and transitivity on 2g+1 Humphries chains; dimension mismatch 3g-4 vs 2g-2; Humphries chains are not simplices of C.
finding_candidates.statement: For top-degree vanishing arguments that identify H^{4g-5}(Mod_g;V)≅(St⊗V)_{Mod} and kill odd Sp-inflated V by forcing S^-=0 on S=(St)_I via hyperelliptic/Birman–Hilden classes, it is not enough that a fixed hyperelliptic involution act as +id on C^{sym}: one must prove that the Mod-orbit of im(b: St(Σ_{0,2g+2})→St_g) generates St_g (equivalently, that a Broaddus cyclic generator lies in that orbit up to units). Arguments that treat maximal simplices or intersecting Humphries chains as Steinberg generators, or that invoke Mod-transitivity on chains to move arbitrary filling carriers into symmetric position, are invalid and do not establish S^-=0.

strongest_attack: Step 5.3 / CLM-0010 (hyperelliptic Birman–Hilden classes generate St_6⊗Q, hence S^-=0): the generation argument is load-bearing for the odd-tensor vcd vanishing and is mathematically incoherent—confuses Steinberg degree 2g-2 with maximal-simplex dimension 3g-4, conflates intersecting Humphries chains with curve-complex simplices, and illegitimately promotes Mod-transitivity on chains into generation of all top homology by symmetric classes—without proving nonvanishing of b or citing a correct cyclic generator (Broaddus φ_0). With S^- unproved zero, (S⊗H^{⊗5})_{Sp} need not vanish, so H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})=0 and W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)=0 remain open. Steps 0–2 survive as the FND-0093 reduction only.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
